title: File System Activity event (attachment + dropped-file telemetry for phishing triage)
summary: OCSF File System Activity events the phishing_triage playbook consumes for attachment evaluation (sandbox verdicts, hash reputation) and, in the malware-attached branch, endpoint observations of artifacts written by a clicked attachment so the endpoint-isolation step can be scoped to affected hosts.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 System Activity category — File System Activity class (uid 1001)
